'''Tarnux''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] around [[3627 BBY]] as an [[Sith Executioner|Executioner]]. He was stationed on [[Mek-Sha]] under the command of his master [[Darth Shaar]] but was killed there [[Mission to Mek-Sha|in battle]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Face Imperial justice!|Tarnux in combat|<ref name="Onslaught" />}}
Tarnux wielded a [[Tarnux's_battlestaff|red-bladed battlestaff]] in combat as opposed to a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was able to utilize [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Wave]] against his opponents. He was also able to [[Force jump/Legends|leap]] across large distances with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
